findings.piObservation: Pi colours the Python builtin name print with the syntax keyword colour (rgb 10983639).
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp leaves print at the default foreground; string literals match.
findings.correction: Add Python builtin-name highlighting to the syntax token table and cover it with a cell-style regression.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S01 80x24/120x40 style cells for print; ui-report.json checkpoint text

findings.piObservation: Pi keeps one reasoning section, renders one Thinking... placeholder while hidden, and restores the joined reasoning block without extra rows.
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp splits reasoning chunks around toggle status lines, shows two Thinking... placeholders, and leaves extra blank/indented rows; the final transcript is shifted by three rows.
findings.correction: Collapse streamed reasoning into one block, keep a single hidden placeholder, and re-render the block in place when visibility changes.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S02 text/layout differences from s02-02 through exit; ui-report.json checkpoint text

findings.piObservation: Pi renders reasoning text with the italic attribute.
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp renders reasoning text without italic.
findings.correction: Apply the reasoning/thinking italic style to every reasoning cell and add a styled-frame regression.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S02 .attributes.italic differences at every visible reasoning checkpoint

findings.piObservation: For a reasoning-capable model Pi draws the Working rule with rgb 6391244.
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp keeps the non-reasoning Working rule colour rgb 7108219.
findings.correction: Select the reasoning-model Working status colour and pin it in a status-style test.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S02 s02-01-before-reasoning Working-rule foreground cells

findings.piObservation: Pi applies the tool error styling to the Error: This operation was aborted row.
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp applies error styling to Operation aborted, but the text span and colour runs differ with the wording.
findings.correction: Render the corrected cancellation error through the same tool-error style path as Pi.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S05 style differences from s05-05 through exit

findings.piObservation: Pi prints the tool-level Command aborted row and then Error: This operation was aborted.
findings.pisharpObservation: PiSharp prints the same Command aborted row but the following error line is Operation aborted.
findings.correction: Render the cancelled tool error with Pi's Error: prefix and abort wording; add a checkpoint assertion.
findings.evidence: comparison.json S05 text differences from s05-05 through exit
